## Proposed maturity

New adapters begin **experimental**.

- [ ] I understand protocol-compatible does not imply equally hardened.
- [ ] I will not create a parallel approval/state/SHA/verdict protocol.
- [ ] I will document enforcement differences honestly.
- [ ] I can provide deterministic conformance evidence.
- [ ] I can provide live host proof before asking for stable support.
